character.description: Exactly four distinct isolated connected near-side shoulder armor caps in canonical131 idle pose order0,1,2,3. Armor-only rigid small pauldron; one physically attached mounting rivet per cap. No body, shirt, arm, hand, chest, detached strap or opposite shoulder. Near/image-left is the wider front deltoid; far/image-right is the compressed deeper shoulder. Do not flip a near cap to make a far cap.
